title: The Big Tree
text:
Our park has a very big tree. It is old and tall. Birds live in its branches. Many children like to sit under it.

In the summer, the tree gives us shade. In the autumn, its leaves turn yellow and fall down. People collect the leaves to make art. The tree is very important for our park.

questions.text: What lives in the branches of the tree?
When does the tree give us shade?
Why is the tree important for the park?
options: It gives animals and people a place to rest and live
It is the only tree in the city

questions.text: How do the children probably feel about the tree?
options: They want to cut it down

vocabulary.definition: the long parts that grow out from the trunk of a tree
a cool dark place where the sun does not reach
the season between summer and winter
to gather things together from different places

paragraph_translations: Nuestro parque tiene un árbol muy grande. Es viejo y alto. Los pájaros viven en sus ramas. A muchos niños les gusta sentarse bajo él.
En verano, el árbol nos da sombra. En otoño, sus hojas se vuelven amarillas y caen al suelo. La gente recoge las hojas para hacer arte. El árbol es muy importante para nuestro parque.
